**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Cobweb](../persons.html#675),
You have been very ill used, but first [Fanny Patteson](../persons.html#1151) was here, and I was idle, and since that I have not been well and have been more idle.

The Acrostic is capital – I always like those that are all quotation- and I am very glad to see the composers going on, this last is a very entertaining piece[^1]
Pray excuse my great stupidity
your affectionate
[Mother Goose](../others.html#104)

[^1]: Tiny blue envelope 92mm x 54mm addressed to Miss Helmore/ Cheyne Walk/Chelsea/ London/ S.W. postmarked Winchester 19 March 1866 and London 20 March 1866.

[^2]: Helmore was contributing a series of articles on composers to the [Barnacle](../others.html#89).
